checks.detail: Slim base (node:22-slim), apt cache cleaned, all packages justified (git/tmux/strace for Harbor, chromium/ffmpeg for Revideo, python3+pip for verifier scoring).
solution/ contains only solve.sh and project.tsx; solve.sh includes useful toolchain validation before copying the reference solution.
Well-structured two-layer verifier with clean-room restore, strace wrapping, source-level anti-cheat, and reward-file audit — all sections serve a purpose.
reasons: useful: chmod 700 + rm -rf /logs/verifier/* lockdown before any agent code runs
useful: source-level grep for banned APIs (fs, child_process, exec, eval, spawn, etc.)
useful: clean-room wipe + pristine tarball restore eliminates planted files, modified node_modules, poisoned configs
useful: pkill -9 -u agent kills lingering background processes before render
useful: strace -f wrapping of render catches forked child processes
useful: strace log grep for openat reward file writes
useful: symlink check on output video prevents trivial reference copy
useful: snapshot project.tsx to /run/ before wipe so agent source survives clean-room

checks.detail: No individual files exceed 30MB; largest is package-lock.json at 144KB.
README.md contains embedded rollout results and detailed anti-cheat analysis that could be split out, but is not dead code per se.
reasons: environment/source_scene.tsx, environment/solution_project.tsx, and solution/project.tsx are byte-identical — intentional per pipeline design (documented in README) but adds 10KB of duplication
environment/solve.sh and solution/solve.sh are byte-identical — same intentional duplication for Docker COPY reliability
qa.toml is a QA artifact that serves ongoing documentation purposes — acceptable

notes: Three identical copies of the solution scene (source_scene.tsx, solution_project.tsx, solution/project.tsx) exist by design — source_scene renders reference.mp4 at build time, solution_project is baked into /solution/ in the image, solution/project.tsx is for Harbor's docker-cp upload. Any future edits must update all three.
